title: Cloud routing inherits claude: a cloud cell without kind, or a tier applied after it, dispatches the claude CLI in the container
body: profile.route applies [roles.X.substrates.cloud] field-wise and then any tier overlay, and only refuses an ABSENT cloud cell. Verified against profile.Resolve with Substrate=cloud: [roles.review] kind=claude + a cloud cell with only model=glm-5.3 resolves runner=claude; [roles.implement.tiers.strong] kind=claude resolves runner=claude model=opus under cloud. The fix is a construction-time check of the FINAL resolved runner/model under cloud (refuse claude, and require the cloud cell to state kind and model); this supersedes 84z's low-severity finding ea1a62d3.
